# Nuclear Cyborg Corp

> Nuclear Cyborg Corp is an AI and software consulting company and an Apple-platform app publisher, founded by Andrew Benson. It offers AI integration and development (LLM fine-tuning, retrieval augmented generation, custom AI agents), enterprise AI consulting, and software architecture services.

- Consultation requests go through the contact page.
- The company publishes iOS and macOS apps on the App Store under the developer name "Nuclear Cyborg Corp".
- IAP Buddy was formerly named Pricing for App Store Connect.

## Services

- [AI Development & Integration](https://nuclearcyborg.com/services/ai-development): LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, custom AI agents, on-device AI, vector database integration and multi-modal AI.
- [Enterprise AI Consulting](https://nuclearcyborg.com/services/ai-consulting): AI strategy, workflow automation, knowledge management and AI infrastructure planning.
- [Software Architecture](https://nuclearcyborg.com/services/software-architecture): System design, technology stack and performance optimization, code quality assessment, security review and scalability.

## Company

- [Home](https://nuclearcyborg.com/): Overview of Nuclear Cyborg Corp's AI and software consulting services.
- [About](https://nuclearcyborg.com/about): The company and its founder, Andrew Benson.
- [Contact](https://nuclearcyborg.com/contact): Request a consultation.

## Apps

- [Drew's Video Socials Scheduler](https://nuclearcyborg.com/apps/scheduler/): Local-first macOS publishing workstation for YouTube creators, with AI-generated descriptions, multi-platform social scheduling and comment moderation.
- [IAP Buddy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/iap-buddy/id6741457652): Mac app for viewing and updating prices of apps, in-app purchases and subscriptions through the App Store Connect API.
- [Nuclear Cyborg Corp on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/nuclear-cyborg-corp/id910010732): All apps the company publishes.

## Founder

- [Andrew Benson on GitHub](https://github.com/drewster99): Open-source projects, including MCP servers and Swift packages.
- [Andrew Benson on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/drewbensondev/): Professional profile.
- [DrewBensonCodes on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DrewBensonCodes): Andrew's YouTube channel.
- [Drew and Dan in the Morning](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/drew-and-dan-in-the-morning/id1894918993): Podcast co-hosted by Andrew; "Dan and Drew talk tech, projects, problems and Apple pie."
